Package br.edu.unipampa.varzinho.domain.structure

package br.edu.unipampa.varzinho.domain.structure
The physical layout of a gym: the Gym and the Courts it owns, each with the cameras installed on it.

A court is where a capture is triggered: pressing its button makes the first camera that is recording freeze its last seconds into a clip. The collections here grow only through named behaviour (addCourt, installCamera, moveCamera), never through a setter. Part of the innermost layer: nothing here imports from the application, the adapters or the window.
